name: Nonmonotone Universal Four-Word Path Test
properties: The cones $z_1>z_2>z_3$ and $z_3>-z_2>z_1$ realize $T$ and its complement, so $T$ is a realizable ample and hence universal substitution test. Its cube graph is a four-vertex path, so no coordinate reflection makes it a rank-one downset on all three coordinates; such a downset has the three-star graph. Thus realizable substitution covers tests beyond the monotone and unate cases.
